Are any of these close to SNL? I'm gonna be in that area in a few weeks and am curious which would be most convenient to check out.

Marble is downtown.

Bosque is on the north end of the city, but right off the highway.
Griefmeat Puppies in Ceder Crest is fantastic, especially with their food items. My only issue is that they only have pilsners. Oh well :-/
